lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's BOCC Special Meeting, where commissioners continue a public hearing on adopting the 2024 International Building Codes along with Colorado's new low-energy and carbon standards — rules that will directly shape what gets built in this county for years to come. Town P&Z also meets Wednesday to take an early look at a proposed School District employee housing project near the middle-high school, and the Resident Advisory Committee digs into tenant surveys, unit vacancies, and housing policies. Plenty of community life fills out the week, from Mariachi San Jose at Oak Street Park to the Telluride Autumn Classic.
